title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Expected Work 2^82.605810489 via Unmodified 0LP (61.50, 61.50) MODE-I (<16 EiB/Node) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS with 0LP Zero-Loss Hybrid Implicit FVS Schur-BW LA

claims.statement: For full-production bn254-pairing-inversion, the scalar ARMv8.1-A machine of proof.md (-march=armv8.1-a -mgeneral-regs-only, simd=0, <16 EiB/node; 24 baseline modules byte-identical to bn254-c6-v43b-pi, no new .s ASM or fp64/SIMD; only verify_bn254_v6.py [1-line W_target fix] and model_bn254_v6.py [la_mode='fvs' + misc FVS build/lift charge] modified alongside audit_bn_cm.py; FEAT_LSE STADDB/LDADD at 1 Ir = 1/20,000 u; uint8_t scale=0.35) runs the unmodified (6,2) MONIC_M1 C6 STNFS Stage-1/2 0LP sieve ((Lf,Lg)=(61.50,61.50), exc=0.72, sl=117.0, log2_V=94.889862, R_a=568.83, IPC=9.0095, collection<=2^83.773593) and unmodified 62-row LB=59.0 12D boot & ECM descent (two_logs<=2^78.941351, phi<=0.340183), with one Stage-3 LA upgrade: 0LP Zero-Loss Hybrid Implicit FVS Schur-BW (bw=(768,32), mdepth=1.0, H3-FVS caps nu_fvs=0.50, nu_d=2.00, W_pre=45.0, k5=8.70, cse=1.00, c_tail_z6=364.0). Augmented A=[M_prod|S_prod] is trimmed to square D x D (D=N_cols+5 rows by N_cols relation + 5 SM cols, rank(A)=D-1 under H-R), with all 5 SM cols pinned in c_2 so exact square Schur system [B_sparse|S_red] in F_r^{M_fvs x M_fvs} has rank M_fvs-1 and ker ~= ker(A); outer BW iterates zero-padded sparse B=[B_sparse|0] with bordered SM start block Y=[S_red,BZ] (0 dense SM MACs per matvec, matching hx_z6.py). O(nnz) bucket-queue FVS selection (charged 2^60 Ir) and one-off S_red + triangular lift (charged 2^58 Ir) are priced in misc. Live audit_bn_cm.py (38/38 checks) verifies: (1) untruncated full-matrix FVS + live square 105x105 trim + 254-bit Schur identity + exact op_hx kernel isomorphism at U=2^13,2^14 (W_target=100.0; 2^15 under part='fvs'); (2) live pure-Python zero-w_mid explicit generator at U=2^10; (3) unplanted 2-sided 5-SM FVS rank-bridge on hx_z6.py F_593 (sm_pinned_in_c2=True, BM deg=6, nullity_S=1, 4-SM nullity=0); and (4) 24 raw zero-w_mid explicit runs 2^14..2^19 (N_l=6,506..180,230, 0 cols lost; M/N_l 0.4895..0.3930 < 0.50; D/N_l 1.2955..1.3253 < 2.00, linear trend ~1.55 at 2^54.5; max k5=6.7588 < 8.70), transferred via Mode-A H3-FVS to baseline NU_L_CAP=0.000205 where production w_mid=0. Cuts la<=2^79.995182 (-0.7800 b) and gen<=2^73.849567 (-1.0629 b), 1-owner LA RAM=2^62.4153 B<=2^62.4901 B exact-rat UB <16 EiB (sensitivities: zero_fvs_baseline_h3 2^82.671767; fvs_u19_040 2^82.562727; fvs_stress_060_250 2^82.651389; live_wmid_stress_058_245_925 2^82.648342). Output (<=2^11.761903 u), verify (<=2^11.000001 u), and stor_bound.py (<=2^97.5798 B<2^100 B, every node <16 EiB) are unchanged. Under H1, H2, H3-FVS, H5, H5-W, H-EB0..H-EB3, H-SM, H-R, H-X, H-ECM, H-SEP (>=0.60), opened-run success >=0.999999 via FIX-U (overall >=0.39 with K=7,194,237,382,984,108,115; gate_0395_slack 2^82.624189) and E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*2^83.964263017 <= 2^82.605810489 units (C=20,000 Ir).

experiments.purpose: Single-threaded pure-stdlib verifier for bn254-pairing-inversion (38/38 default checks: 34 v43b-pi baseline + 4 live 0LP FVS Schur-BW checks: untruncated full-matrix FVS with live square 105x105 trim & op_hx kernel iso at W_target=100.0; live zero-w_mid explicit generator at U=2^10; unplanted 5-SM FVS rank-bridge with sm_pinned_in_c2 & BM deg=6; 24-run calibration 2^14..2^19 & exact-rat RAM UB <=2^62.4902 B at bw=(768,32)).
